messages:
Nina: Circle up 1: speaker lock + dry runs for May webinar. Focus: low-latency inference demos + migration story. 40 min total.
Sam: I'm leaning 2 live demos + 1 customer cameo. Keep it tight.
Rui: Agree. Proposal: one infra-heavy demo (latency tuning), one product demo (easy migration), customer cameo for ROI numbers.
Lena: Candidate speakers:
- Tom (infra, will show batching + cache)
- Pri (product, migration guides)
- Hana (customer, cost reduction story)
Tom: I can do live demo but need SSH access to staging and a test API key. No VPN.
Pri: prefer recorded demo + live commentary; timezone: CET afternoons.
Hana: happy to present slides + 3-min prerecorded clip of before/after metrics.
Nina: Good. Let's score quickly (1-5): domain_fit, demo_ready, timezone, audience_pull.
Rui: Quick scores (Tom 5/4/5/4 -> 18, Pri 4/3/3/4 -> 14, Hana 4/5/3/5 -> 17).
Sam: That puts Tom & Hana as must-haves, Pri as optional backup. Fine by me.
Nina: Dry run windows (pick two): May 2 9:30am PT (NA-friendly) and May 4 4pm CET (EU-friendly). Can Tom do both?
Tom: I can do May 2 morning only. Hana can do both. Pri only May 4 CET.
Lena: Run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-00:03 host intro + sponsor mention
00:03-00:18 Tom live demo (latency tuning)
00:18-00:25 Hana customer ROI + clip
00:25-00:32 Pri migration story (recorded + live Q)
00:32-00:38 panel Q (all)
00:38-00:40 CTA + landing + 48h promo code
```
mk-ops-bot: Reminder schedule set: 72h, 24h, 1h, 10m. Will send speaker checklist 7 days before.
Nina: Lead routing: landing page to use utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=migrate-with-redwood. Attendee tagging: "attended=true" and "asked_q" if they submit a question. Route to pipeline: webinar-warm.
Sam: Follow-up play: attendees get 48h trial + migration checklist PDF. Non-attendees get recording + 7-day drip.
Rui: A/B subject line for registration emails: (A) "Cut inference costs: live demo" vs (B) "Migrate without rewrites: see how". We'll track CTR -> registration -> attendance.
Lena: Tech checklist for rehearsal (short): stable staging key, recorded fallback for Tom, slide build in single deck, clear slide with demo creds. Also note browser constraints (Chrome recommended).
Nina: Failure modes: 1) live demo fails: switch to recorded clip + live walkthrough. 2) audio issues: swap to chat Q + continue. 3) out-of-time: cut panel Q. Document fallback scripts.
Sam: Action items: Sam reach Tom/Hana to confirm availability today. Rui build landing page copy and promo assets. Lena prepare rehearsal doc & fallback clips. mk-ops-bot will schedule invites after confirmations.
Nina: Let's lock speakers by EOD tomorrow so we can send calendar invites and rehearsal decks. Thanks all. :sparkles:
